steps.say: A burst bowel leaks air that rises to the diaphragm and shows as a dark crescent on an upright chest film. When the plain film is silent, a contrast scan finds the hole with high accuracy.
steps.tx: Perforated viscus shows **free air** (escaped bowel gas) under the diaphragm on erect chest film in **70 percent** (seventy percent), and CT with oral contrast locates the site with **90 percent** (ninety percent) accuracy when films are negative and clinical suspicion stays high through the assessment.

vis.alt: Bedside examination of a rigid abdomen with panels of guarding, silent bowel and a chest film with air.
vis.caption: Perforation examination: board-like rigidity, obliterated liver dullness, silent bowel and free air under the diaphragm. Credit: University of Washington Virtual Patient.

steps.say: Scoring systems turn bedside findings into a number that predicts survival. High scores send the patient to intensive care and favour a short damage-control operation over a long definitive one.
steps.tx: **Mannheim peritonitis index** (belly-sepsis score, the **Mannheim index**) over **26** (twenty six) and **APACHE II** (intensive-care score) over **15** (fifteen) predict mortality and intensive care need, guiding **damage control** (abbreviated life-saving surgery) against definitive repair in sick patients everywhere always.

steps.say: Cold, acidotic and bleeding patients cannot survive a long operation. The surgeon staples and closes quickly, corrects physiology in intensive care, and returns in a day or two to finish properly.
steps.tx: **Damage control laparotomy** (cut-short emergency surgery) with abbreviated resection, stapled ends and temporary closure suits unstable acidotic coagulopathic patients, with relook at **24 to 48 hours** (one to two days) for definitive reconstruction once the **lethal triad** (cold, acid, clot failure) of coagulopathy is corrected fully.

vis.alt: Swollen septic abdomen with pressure effects on chest vessels and kidneys plus an open-abdomen inset.
vis.caption: Peritonitis with compartment effects and open-abdomen decompression for pressure relief. Credit: StewardMD.

steps.say: Leaving the belly open is graded like a wound, from clean to frozen solid. Suction dressings with steady pulling on the edges bring the walls together for closure within days.
steps.tx: **Open abdomen** (unclosed belly) with **Bjorck grades 1A** (clean open) to **4** (frozen solid) guides temporary closure choice, with **negative-pressure therapy** (suction dressing) and early fascial traction for primary closure within the first week whenever feasible and safe under specialist supervision.

steps.say: Stool spilled from the large bowel demands removal of the diseased segment with the upper end brought to the skin. Right-sided holes in stable patients can be joined at once.
steps.tx: Colonic perforation with **faecal peritonitis** (stool soilage) gets **Hartmann** (rectal stump with end stoma) resection in contamination, while right-sided perforations with stable physiology suit resection with ileocolic anastomosis in one planned sitting when contamination is modest despite the overnight delay here.

steps.say: Typhoid eats multiple holes near the end of the small bowel in endemic areas. Simple stitches fail because new holes follow, so the diseased length comes out as one piece.
steps.tx: **Typhoid perforation** (fever germ bowel holes) clusters within **60 cm** (sixty centimetres) of the valve with multiple antimesenteric **ileal ulcers** (small-bowel sores), treated by **segmental resection** (length removal) rather than simple closure in endemic zones with heavy loads and late presentation.

steps.say: Tuberculous bellies feel doughy and fill with fluid rich in a marker enzyme. Drugs cure most without surgery, which is kept for blocked or burst bowel after medicines have started.
steps.tx: **Tuberculous peritonitis** (TB belly lining) with doughy abdomen, ascitic **adenosine deaminase** (TB fluid marker) over **30 units per L** (thirty units) and omental caking needs antitubercular therapy first, with surgery only for obstruction or perforation after medicines begin working steadily.

steps.say: Tuberculous narrowings are stretched open rather than removed when short, saving precious bowel. Long or multiple diseased lengths come out after medicines have shrunk the inflammation.
steps.tx: Abdominal tuberculosis strictures, the classic **tuberculous stricture** (TB narrowing), get **stricturoplasty** (widening repair) for short lesions and resection for long or multiple ones after **2 months** (two months) of antitubercular therapy, preserving maximum absorptive length for nutrition always and steadily.
